column1: # Published data: non-thermal X-ray photon index versus neutron-star surface temperature for the 12 thermally detected pulsars in the Hsiang & Chang sample.

# Meaning: x is log10 of the fitted thermal temperature T in eV/k; y is the pulsar power-law photon index Gamma. The paper used orthogonal distance regression because both coordinates have uncertainties.
# Published fit: Gamma = (4.32 +/- 0.66) - (1.23 +/- 0.31)*log10(T); reduced chi^2=9.55. Parameter uncertainties are 68% confidence.
# X and Y standard deviations below are symmetrized helpers from the published asymmetric 68% errors; original lower/upper errors are retained in later columns.
